**Summary:**  
Adds cluster/guest diagnostics and health triage tools; expands governance and removes legacy metadata.

- Introduced diagnostics tools for node pressure and guest health (RCA/triage support).
- Tool count increases from 39 to 43, covering new read-only diagnostics.
- Now supports health-driven usage, e.g., "why is proxmox slow" and "node pressure".
- Improved documentation and metadata for discoverability (summary, tags, slug, etc.).
- Removed the deprecated skill-card.md file; added agent guardrails documentation.
- General updates for clarity, feature coverage, and governance explainer.

- No changes to toolset; user functionality and compatibility remain unchanged.

Version 0.2.0 of proxmox-aiops introduces expanded Proxmox VE management coverage.

- Added support for disk operations (grow/move), vzdump backup/restore, cluster inventory, HA status, pools, VM firewall, and guest agent ping.
- Number of MCP tools increased from 23 to 39, including new read and write operations.
- Broader CLI commands and usage documentation to reflect the expanded feature set.
- Skill-card.md file removed for cleanup.
- Documentation updated for new workflows and capability details.
v0.1.0 first release: standalone governed Proxmox VE ops — 23 MCP tools with built-in audit/budget/undo/risk-tier harness
